correctness.rationale: Actual icosahedral coordinates yield 30 mid-edge roots and the full icosidodecahedral dual facet set (12 pentagons and 20 triangles). For each root n, orthogonal reflection R_n permutes all 12 icosahedron vertices and hence preserves the hyperplane arrangement. Adjacent chambers are related by their facet-wall reflections; connected chamber graph forces every generic direction to illuminate exactly (3 five-valent,7 three-valent) dual vertices, as certified by one exact sign sample. Strict inequalities show nongeneric directions have at most that count. Five-valent vertex count gives i(P),i*(P)>=12/3=4, and four explicit directions cover every vertex giving i=i*=4. Independent geometry recreated all roots, face signs, 360 reflections numerically and four-direction cover; source code verifies in exact Z[phi], so numerical tolerances are not the proof.
